title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Finland – EGF/2026/003 FI/Valmet Automotive
part_text: 6. Recalls that, in consultation with experts and in agreement with social partners, personalised services to be provided to the displaced workers consist of the following measures: job-seeking training; job and career coaching; vocational training; occupational safety and competence cards; language training; start-up grants; incentives and allowances; stresses that trade union representatives should be involved throughout the entire implementation of the EGF measures, including the monitoring and evaluation phase, to ensure the quality and relevance of the support offered to beneficiaries; highlights the importance of ensuring that training and requalification measures respond to concrete labour market needs, facilitate the rapid reintegration of displaced workers and prevent long-term unemployment including for older workers; notes that EUR 230 000, representing 34,65 % of the personalised services package and thus almost the maximum share permitted under the EGF Regulation, has been allocated to pay subsidies for only 23 beneficiaries, amounting to EUR 10 000 per beneficiary; calls on the Finnish authorities to demonstrate that each subsidised position constitutes additional and sustainable employment and does not displace unsubsidised employment;
